about_the_game:
The Lost Harvest is the first major DLC for Dune: Awakening. Set out on a complete standalone storyline with new areas to explore and cosmetic items to collect.

The Lost Harvest DLC is included in the Dune: Awakening Season Pass.

The Mithra, a spice harvester, has been shot from the sky during transport. The wreckage still burns, and the Kirab are scouring the remains. But there are still survivors that need your help.

Arrakis is full of secrets. Ancient things, buried deep. What starts as a simple rescue mission on the Mithra will take you on a journey which will have you face one of the Imperium's greatest threats.

Key Features:

  • Journey: Experience a new standalone storyline, an epic journey that draws on the deep lore of the Dune universe.

  • Vehicle: The Treadwheel is a new land vehicle with unique animations.

  • 3 Expanded Imperial Testing Stations: Plunge the depths of these new areas filled with loot, secrets, and danger.

  • Dune Man Building Pieces: Get four new building pieces for your base, in the style of the weathered Dune Men of Arrakis.

  • 5 Decorations to put in your base.

  • 2 Armor Skins

  • 4 Weapon Skins

  • Thumper Emote

short_description: In The Lost Harvest DLC for Dune: Awakening, experience a new standalone storyline and get a list of cosmetics, including armors, weapons, and the Treadwheel vehicle. Uncover the mystery of a crashed Miner’s Guild harvester, and hunt down its stolen cargo. It could change everything.
